displayName: OJ — Sandbox pool at 0 for any language (60 s)

documentation.content: `sandbox_pool_ready` has been 0 for any language (python/cpp/java) for more than 60 s. New leases for that language wait for cold-start (Firecracker boot + rootfs hydration, ~1.5 s) and will queue. Sustained empty state implies submission rate > replenishment rate or a sandbox-manager bug. Check `docker logs oj-sandbox-manager` and the per-language pool replenishment rate. The pool target is configured at startup (`python:2 / cpp:1 / java:1` by default).
